context: Single-view annotated stock price line chart showing 500 trading days of a synthetic crash-and-recovery narrative, with callout annotations, event markers, a trend line, average band, range arrow, and Voronoi tooltip.
first_impression: Clean and readable — the annotations are well-placed and the narrative is immediately legible without feeling cluttered.
what_works: The restrained 4-color Tol palette keeps categorical elements distinct without overload; the force-simulation collision avoidance on callout labels prevents overlap and the elbow leader lines clearly connect labels to their data points.
what_doesnt: The top-of-chart event label area is tight — 'Sell-off begins' and 'Market trough' labels are close enough to nearly collide, and the range arrow (crash depth) is positioned mid-chart but its horizontal anchor is ambiguous since it sits between the sell-off and trough markers rather than clearly spanning peak-to-trough on the x-axis.
